title: Loose-fill insulation material.
officialText: Loose-fill insulation material, insulating foam sealants and caulk materials shall not be used as a fire block unless specifically tested in the form and manner intended for use to demonstrate its ability to remain in place and to retard the spread of fire and hot gases.
